The Uncanny Counter Season 2

경이로운 소문 2: 카운터 펀치 (Gyeongiroun Somun 2: Kaunteo Peonchi)

K-Drama · Series · South Korea · 2023

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐∞/10

Overview

Three years after Season 1, the Counters continue hunting evil spirits. Their enemies have become much stronger, while a new Counter, Na Jeok-bong, joins the team. The season also follows Ma Joo-seok, a kind firefighter whose life is destroyed after losing his pregnant wife, eventually turning him into one of the Counters' most difficult enemies.

My Review

Season 2 became even more laughable and fun because Jeok-bong had the same chaotic energy as So Mun. HAHAHAHA. I still loved the Counter group — So Mun, Do Ha-na, Ga Mo-tak, Ms. Chu, Jangmul, and Jeok-bong. The villains were also much stronger this time, which made the fights feel even more intense. I really liked how the Counters had to face enemies who could actually challenge them. Ma Joo-seok was probably the most complicated for me. What he did was unforgivable, but I understood where his anger came from. He had lost his pregnant wife, and seeing the kindest man become a powerful evil spirit because of that pain was heartbreaking. I could understand his pain without excusing his actions. The scene that hurt me the most was Ha-na erasing Do-hwi's memories of her. She did it because she wanted to protect him, but damn — it still felt unfair. I really wanted them to have more. I also thought Han-ul was handsome. HAHAHAHA. I originally thought Suho was the only handsome man in the series, but Season 2 made me realize Han-ul was also VERY attractive. If I couldn't marry Suho, I would be okay with Han-ul. Actually, forget that — I want both. HAHAHAHA. I also loved the development with Ma Joo-seok, especially when everyone thought Han-ul had died and Mo-tak and So Mun were ready to kill Joo-seok. Then they discovered that Joo-seok had actually healed Han-ul because the real Joo-seok was still fighting inside himself while Pil-gwang controlled his body and mind. Jeok-bong was also such a fun addition. His ability to smell evil spirits sounds ridiculous at first, but it became extremely useful, especially when dealing with powerful Level 3 spirits that could sense and avoid the Territory. And Jangmul remains the group's sugar daddy. HAHAHAHA. He doesn't need psychokinesis when his money can solve half their problems. I was also really happy that Ms. Chu found happiness again through Jae-youl, because she felt like she had another son. Overall, it was a really fun journey. I laughed more in Season 2, enjoyed the stronger villains, loved the Counters, and appreciated how their abilities developed. The story of the evil spirits gaining the powers of the Counters they killed in China also made the villains feel much more dangerous.

Favorite Scene/Part

• Jeok-bong joining the Counters. • Jeok-bong's ridiculous but extremely useful ability to smell evil spirits. • The Counters fighting the much stronger Level 3 spirits. • Ma Joo-seok healing Han-ul despite Pil-gwang controlling him. • Ha-na erasing Do-hwi's memories. • Ms. Chu finding happiness through Jae-youl.

Favorite Quote/Lines

“They say life’s full of ups and downs. After all that hardship, good things are happening.”
